verdict: Broadcom's revenue jumped 86% to a record $29.6B because one product line — custom AI chips for the big cloud builders — tripled in a year.

kpis.label: AI semiconductor revenue
kpis.note: +221% YoY — over half of all revenue

segments.name: Semiconductor solutions
segments.note: Chips — above all custom AI accelerators and networking gear for data centers. AI semiconductor revenue alone was $16.7B, up 221% YoY.

segments.name: Infrastructure software
segments.note: VMware and other enterprise software — the steady, subscription side of the company.

opex.name: Research & development
opex.note: Designing the next chips and software — Broadcom spends a smaller share of each revenue dollar here than most chip rivals.

opex.name: Selling, general & administrative
opex.note: Selling the products and running the company.

opex.name: Amortization & restructuring
opex.note: Mostly writing down the value of brands and technology bought in acquisitions (VMware above all) — a bookkeeping charge, not cash — plus restructuring costs.

takeaways.title: AI chips are the story
takeaways.text: AI semiconductor revenue hit $16.7B — more than Broadcom's entire company revenue a year ago — and management guided it to $21.7B next quarter.

takeaways.title: Next quarter looks bigger
takeaways.text: Guidance calls for revenue of about $34.8B in Q4, up 93% YoY — growth is accelerating, not cooling.

takeaways.title: A cash machine
takeaways.text: Free cash flow was $13.7B — 46 cents of every revenue dollar — because software-like margins now sit on top of a chip business.

oneTimers: GAAP profit carries $2,006M of amortization of acquisition-related intangible assets (split between cost of revenue and operating expenses) and $2,019M of stock-based pay — mostly non-cash charges. On Broadcom's non-GAAP view, EPS was $3.32 instead of $2.68.
otherDetail: Interest expense of $778M on Broadcom's large debt stack (taken on for acquisitions), partly offset by $98M of other income — a net $680M cost below operating profit.
follow100Note: The rows reconcile to $100 at this rounding.
